messages:
Alex C: Quick heads-up — during a kb-link sweep I found a couple issues on /runtime/onboarding: the code sample shortlink 404s and the hero screenshot is serving 403 from the CDN. Can someone claim ownership? Posting findings below.

Sam (docs-bot): Automated scan result: 
- page: /runtime/onboarding
- issue: sample-snippet (shortlink) -> 404 -> https://short.red/abc123
- issue: image /assets/onboarding/hero.png -> 403 (cdn).
See full scan: https://internal.kb/scan/2161616161

Mira P: I can take the sample snippet (onboarding docs). Tagging @Joel R for image rehost — Joel, do you have access to the original asset or should we re-export? Also, do we want to replace the shortlink with the canonical example or remove it entirely?

Joel R: I can rehost the image on the docs CDN if someone can upload the original. Do we have it in the `docs/assets` repo? :eyes:

Alex C: Replacement is straightforward. Prefer full upstream raw link so it doesn't rot. Proposed change: replace shortlink with the raw GitHub example. I'll open a quick PR. Example command to use in the doc: `curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/redwoodinc/runtime/main/examples/onboard.sh | bash`

Alex C: PR opened: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/4827 — includes snippet replacement and initial image path update. Diff excerpt:
```diff
- curl -s https://short.red/abc123 | bash
+ curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/redwoodinc/runtime/main/examples/onboard.sh | bash
```

Mira P: Thanks — I'll review the snippet change. Can we also add `custodian: onboarding-team` to the frontmatter so ownership shows up in the next sweep?

Joel R: Uploaded candidate hero.png to `docs-cdn/uploads/2161616161-hero.png` and updated the doc reference in the PR to point to that path. If you want different sizing/compression, say the target and I can run it.

Alex C: :thumbsup: I updated the PR to include frontmatter and the new image path. Also added a tiny smoke test so future scans catch shortlinks in code blocks. CI run: https://ci.internal/gh/4827 (green)

Sam (docs-bot): Tagging: `needs-review`. Requested reviewer from CODEOWNERS.

Mira P: Reviewing now. Small nits: alt text could be clearer — suggest `alt: "Runtime onboarding hero"`. Also, let's compress the PNG to ~80% quality to save bytes; I'll push a follow-up commit for compression.

Joel R: Left a review note on the PR about responsive image width. @Mira PTAL on compression commit once it's up.

Alex C: Thanks both. If Mira's compression is the only follow-up, I'm fine merging after that.

Mira P: I'll push compression + alt text tweak in a minute and request final review.

Alex C: Last ping — merging in 24h if no objections :alarm_clock:

Joel R: :eyes: queued to re-review after compression commit.

Sam (docs-bot): Update: PR 4827 marked `in-review` by Mira P.
